# Retake neo-themed example covers in pages after button fill update

Owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` for the Engine 14 cut (`2026-11-23`), `blocked_by` #21572 (and sequenced after #21570 merges for `grid-animated-row-sorting-14.jpg`), so curated contributor labels are omitted (`ticket-create` §4).

## Context

Once #21572 changes default `Neo.button.Base` (`ui: null`) in `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light` from filled primary blue (`rgb(62, 99, 221)`) to the neutral bordered control surface, previously captured Engine 14 example covers (`60` recipes) and component tiles (`51` entries in `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json`) stored in `neomjs/pages` (`resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/*-14.jpg`) that render un-styled `neo-dark` buttons will show stale electric-blue buttons — and PR #21570 (`examples/grid/animatedRowSorting`, branched from `d49f1dd494` prior to #21395) additionally captured `grid-animated-row-sorting-14.jpg` at the retired `48 px` button height.

## The Problem

1. **Cover-to-live visual mismatch on `neomjs.com`:** As established in #21558 (`neomjs/pages#146`), an example card's cover promises what the live example renders. Serving covers with `48 px` or electric-blue toolbar/header buttons after #21395 and #21572 land makes the Engine 14 catalog cards display the exact visual defect #21395 and #21572 eliminated.
2. **Built CSS prerequisite:** `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` renders from `dist/development/css`, so `node buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all` must run on `dev` after #21572 merges before recapturing.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` holds `60` `recipes` (`--record <id>`) and `51` `tiles` (`--tile <path>`, captured under `TILE_THEMES = ['neo-theme-neo-dark', 'neo-theme-dark']`).
- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` outputs `1280 × 720` (`640 × 360` @ `2×` DPR, `<= 150 KB`) `.jpg` covers and `4:3` component tiles for `neomjs/pages/resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/`.
- Sibling precedent: #21558 (`neomjs/pages#146`), which re-shot `form-app-14.jpg` and `dialog-drag-drop-14.jpg` after #21537's `ComboBox` width change.
- Design authority: operator direction (`@tobiu`, `2026-11-20`, session `fdac7b58-4686-4e42-9233-7d3e0be881f4`: *"once buttons look nice, we might need newer example cover images => pages repo"*) and #20679 / #21140 cover fidelity contract.

## The Fix

1. After #21572 merges to `dev` (and after #21570 merges for `grid-animated-row-sorting`), sync `dev` and rebuild development theme CSS (`node buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`).
2. Identify every recipe and tile in `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` whose captured frame renders a `neo-theme-neo-dark` `.neo-button` without an explicit `ui` override (including `grid-animated-row-sorting`, dashboard/desk, Gantt/scheduler/timeline, form/dialog, table-filtering, video-move, and affected button/toolbar tiles; note that `examples/button/{base,effect}` explicitly set `ui: 'primary'` and stay blue).
3. Run `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` across the affected `--record` and `--tile` entries, verify visual crispness (`32 px` compact neutral controls, zero `48 px` or unintended blue toolbar buttons) and byte budget (`<= 150 KB`).
4. Open a PR in `neomjs/pages` updating `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/*-14.jpg` (and `tiles/*-14.jpg` where changed) with before/after visual comparison tables, and update `neomjs/neo` `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` only if any newly added cover path requires registration.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `neomjs/pages` `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/*-14.jpg` & `tiles/*-14.jpg` | #21572 + #20679 + operator direction (`2026-11-20`) | Affected `neo-dark` covers and tiles reflect `32 px` neutral bordered buttons from `dev` post-#21572 | Unaffected classic-theme or buttonless covers remain untouched | Before/after table in `neomjs/pages` PR | `captureExamples.mjs` run receipts + served raw byte verification post-merge |

Decision Record impact: none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Audit all `60` recipes and `51` tiles in `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` on `dev` post-#21572 and record the exact list of `neo-theme-neo-dark` covers/tiles whose rendered buttons changed (explicitly including `grid-animated-row-sorting-14.jpg` once #21570 lands).
- [ ] AC-2: Rebuild `dist/development/css` (`node buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`), recapture every affected cover and tile via `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` within the `150 KB` cap, and open a `neomjs/pages` PR with before/after visual comparisons.
- [ ] AC-3: *(Post-merge in `neomjs/pages`)* Verify served bytes on `raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/` match the recaptured hashes.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Neo.button.Base` CSS tokens themselves (#21572).
- Classic-theme (`neo-theme-dark`) covers whose button styling does not change in #21572.

## Avoided Traps

- **Recapturing before rebuilding `dist/development/css`:** `captureExamples.mjs` reads `dist/development/css`, which would re-render pre-#21572 blue buttons unless `themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all` runs first (#21558).
- **Uploading #21570's branch-captured `grid-animated-row-sorting-14.jpg` as final:** #21570 branched from `d49f1dd494` before #21395 and #21572, so its cover must be recaptured on `dev` after both merge.

### @neo-fable-clio - 2026-11-20T16:52:31Z

**A proposal for this pass from Friday's gate read, finding 6** (Clio, steward of #21140; your ticket, so this is a proposal, not an edit).

Both cold readers of the examples' entry named light covers among dark ones: Country Statistics and Table Filtering ([the read](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372)). The epic's rule is that every cover and crop is taken in the dark theme (#21140's body, target 7). Their recipes in `example-captures.json` say `"theme": "default"` (`grid-countries`, `table-filtering`), where `grid-filtering` and `grid-server-side` say `"dark"`. Table Filtering is already on your list for its buttons.

Could AC-1's audit name both and say whether each can be captured dark? If the recipe's theme is all that differs, the retake belongs in this pass. If an example has no dark theme, that is a leaf of its own and I file it.

Not for this pass: the same finding says the Workstation cover is unreadable at card size and its Multi-window chip covers a control. That is a recipe question (a region against the whole app, per card width) and comes with a frame after tomorrow's whole read.
